recipe.title: Three Minute Tomato Sauce
recipe.description: A quick and easy tomato sauce made with chilli, garlic, basil, tomatoes, and pasta. The recipe also includes frozen peas and optional ingredients like tuna or olives.
instructions: Put a pan on full heat.
Add the garlic and chilli to the pan.
Slice the basil stalks and add them to the pan.
Chop the tomatoes and rub them in your hand to break them up.
Clean out the tin with a little swig of water.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the pan.
Add the lasagna sheets to the pan.
Cook the pasta in the seasoned water.
Drain the pasta and feed it just a little bit of the water.
Toss the pasta in the sauce for 30 seconds.
Add Parmesan cheese to the pasta.
Top with smaller basil leaves, extra virgin olive oil, and feta cheese.
recipe.notes: The heat is in the white part of the chilli and the seeds. Use your hand to crush the tomatoes for a better flavor. The water from cooking the pasta can be used to make the dish more flavorful.
